sources.evidence_locator: Install the skills; Verify the install, not just the files
sources.evidence_text: Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add qingsongcui/claude-code-skills; /plugin install starter@george-onair-skills; /reload-plugins. Plugin skills are namespaced, e.g. /starter:skill-authoring. Plain clients: copy each individual skill directory into the host's skills directory; do not copy the enclosing skills/ directory as one nested skill. Verify: ask the agent to list matching skills, invoke one explicitly, run the preflight, confirm a JSON verdict. A copied folder alone is not proof that a host discovered it. Cursor and OpenCode path/discovery behavior varies by host version.
